{{Quote|What the?!|Magaloof|audio=Magaloof.flac|<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Magaloof''' was a criminal [[Leffingite]] [[Gender|male]] from<ref name="DB" /> the [[species]]' [[homeworld]]<ref name="Alien Archive">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref> [[Almak]] who worked as a [[speeder]] [[thief]]<ref name="DB" /> on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]].</ref> he was joyriding in a stolen speeder past the [[Bonadan Embassy]] when he narrowly avoided colliding with [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was hanging from the [[assassin droid]] [[ASN-121]]<ref name="Locations" /> as it flew through the busy [[skylane]]s of Coruscant.<ref name="DB" /> The sight caused the Leffingite to exclaim in confusion<ref name="AOTC" /> as although he had seen a lot since coming to Coruscant, a Jedi dangling from a [[droid]] [[kilometer]]s above the ground was new even to him.<ref name="DB" />

Magaloof was later mentioned in an [[Unidentified artist|artist's]] [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]], which was restored, expanded, and displayed at the [[Graf Archive]]<ref name="Alien Archive" /> at some point no earlier than [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Year">{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}}</ref> The Leffingite had [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s and orange skin, and stood 1.4 [[meter]]s tall.<ref name="DB" /> He wore a red [[Clothing|shirt]] with a white collar during his joyride.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Magaloof first appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> in which he was voiced by<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=2016 Topps Star Wars: Attack of the Clones 3D Widevision|cardname=Matthew Wood as Magaloof|link=https://www.ebay.com/itm/175187901844}}</ref> supervising sound editor<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Matthew Wood]].<ref name="Topps" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was first identified in an entry on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]],<ref name="DB" /> which had been published by [[February 8]], [[2016]].<ref name="DBOldest">{{Databank|magaloof|Magaloof|oldversion=20160208191550}}</ref> The [[Magaloof/Legends|name]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', which was written by [[Curtis Saxton]] and [[Simon Beecroft]].<ref name="InsideAOTC">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>
